text: Bought the Voltrix NB-200 noise-cancelling headphones for my commute. The sound is rich, the battery lasts me a full week, and the noise cancelling actually blocks the train rumble. Arrived the next morning, well ahead of the estimate. Worth every penny at this price, and it came in a compact, fully recyclable box.
What could we improve? Honestly nothing. The sofa was delivered on the agreed day and the two drivers carried it up three flights of stairs without a single scratch on the walls.
Wonderful, only three weeks late. By the time the running shoes showed up, the marathon I bought them for was already over. Brilliant planning, Rapidlane couriers.

The ceramic plant pots came in a thin paper bag with no padding at all, so two of the three were cracked when I opened it. The one that survived is lovely, thick glaze and a nice weight. The seller did refund the broken ones quickly after one message.
Not bad at all, and not overpriced either. My picky beagle finished the whole bowl of Barkwell lamb kibble, which never happens.
Would recommend to friends: quick shipping, and the chat agent fixed my wrong house number in about two minutes.

The Brightmart app keeps logging me out, but whatever. The real problem: my grocery order came with squashed tomatoes and a leaking milk carton because everything was thrown into one bag with no separation. My complaint to support has been 'in review' for nine days.
Shoutout to @PetalandQuill for the gorgeous hand-poured candles. Zero plastic in the box, just recycled paper and a handwritten note 🌿

The Lumora smart bulbs connect to the app instantly and the colours are vivid. Support was useless though: I asked how to set a schedule and got a copy-paste reply about resetting my router. At 9 euros a bulb they're still a bargain.
Very good table, the wood is solid and have nice smell. But the delivery man leave it outside in the rain for hours, I was at home and he not even ring. I am not happy about this.
Solid packaging, fair price, and the seller answered my message within minutes.
What could we improve? Answer the phone. I called four times about my missing refund and was on hold for over forty minutes each time.
Compared to the Kettleworks model I had before, this Aurelle kettle boils faster and is much quieter. Also about 20 euros cheaper, and it was at my door the next morning. Happy switch.

The Solenne night cream smells amazing and my skin feels softer after a week. At 58 dollars for a tiny 30ml jar, though, it is seriously overpriced. It does come in a lovely heavy glass jar in a recyclable carton, I'll give them that.

Ordered a birthday present for my niece and asked on the chat whether it could be sent straight to her with a note. The agent set it all up in two minutes, and she says the craft kit came in a gorgeous gift box tied with a ribbon.

Ordered 40 kg of compost and a pair of pruning shears from Greenmoss Supply. Arrived in two days, the bags were double-wrapped so there was no mess on my doorstep, and the shears cut through thick branches like butter.

The Trailfinch yoga mat has great grip even in hot yoga, and the price was half what the big brands charge. Only downside: it arrived nine days after the promised date, the tracking never updated, and support just told me to 'be patient'.

I really wanted to like the Vantora washing machine, but about five weeks in it started leaking from underneath the door, a little at first and then enough to soak the bathroom mat every cycle. I opened a ticket, sent photos and even a video of the leak, and was promised a call back within 48 hours. That was three weeks ago. I've chased twice since and got the same automated email both times. Right now I have a machine I can't use and nobody to talk to about it.
Fits perfectly, fabric feels premium, and it was on sale. Ordering a second colour.

I usually love this shop and I've recommended it to half my office, so this hurts to write. The linen shirt I bought for a wedding shrank two sizes in the first gentle wash, exactly as the label said, and the seams at the shoulders are already coming apart. I emailed to ask whether this was normal and nobody bothered to reply, not even an automated message.
I ordered the wrong size of hiking boots, my own fault. The lady on the phone emailed me a prepaid return label straight away and the refund landed in my account the same week. Painless.
The phone case is sturdy, fits my Nexa 12 perfectly and only cost 8 euros, but why does a tiny case need a shoebox-sized carton and three layers of bubble wrap? So much waste.

Second week in a row the Crateful Kitchen box turned up after 9pm, and this time the portions were tiny and the pre-made sauce tasted like nothing. At 70 euros a week that's simply not acceptable. Cancelling my subscription.
Quick delivery, great quality, will buy again from this seller.
The hardcover edition of The Salt Orchard came wrapped in cardboard corners and shrink film, not a single dent. Lovely print quality and a sewn binding at a paperback price.
Lower your delivery fees. Paying 6.50 to ship a 4 euro bottle of shampoo makes no sense.
My cats love the Whiskerway scratching tower, they fight over the top platform every evening. It did cost more than I wanted to spend, and it showed up four days late.
Thank you for wrapping a glass vase in a single sheet of newspaper. Really creative. It arrived in about fifteen pieces.
I messaged the chat at 11pm to change the colour on my order, expecting nothing, and a real person answered within a minute and updated it. Impressive.

For 240 pounds I expected the Corvex smartwatch to last more than a day on a charge. The screen also scratches if you look at it wrong, and when I asked about it the chat just sent me a link to the manual.
The Nordhem desk was packed like a museum piece: every panel in a foam sleeve, screws labelled by step. Delivered on the exact day promised, assembly took 40 minutes, and it's rock solid.
Courier dropped the parcel at the wrong house and the tracking said 'delivered'. The support team was brilliant though, they called the courier themselves and sent a replacement the next day.
Product is good but price too high for me, in my country is half.

There was no seal and no bag around my Aurum Glow serum, just the bottle loose in a big box, so half of it had leaked out by the time I opened the parcel. Then the refund form kept crashing and the helpline told me to 'try again later'.
Ordered a pair of football boots on Sunday night and they were on my doorstep Monday afternoon. Box was well protected, and it was the cheapest price I could find online too.
Shopping in the Cartella app is smooth, and I love that the courier's location shows live on the map so I know exactly when to be home.

The garden hose itself is great, no kinks and the nozzle has seven settings. What wasn't great was asking support whether it's safe for drinking water: two emails, two different answers, and neither agent seemed to know the product.
Jacket color is not like in picture, is more brown than green. Also the zip is broken after one week, and the package come very late, almost 3 weeks. Very disappointed.
Loved that the whole order came in one recycled box with paper tape and no plastic filler. The lipsticks are creamy, last all day, and were cheaper than at the department store.
Last time I ordered from Hollowbrook it arrived in two days. This time: eleven days and three 'sorry for the delay' emails. No idea what changed but it's much worse.
Prices are genuinely lower than my local supermarket and the fruit is always fresh. But the driver never brings the bags to the door, just leaves them at the gate, even when I've asked in the notes.

The Breezor air purifier is whisper quiet on the night setting and my allergies have calmed down a lot. Came well protected in thick moulded cardboard, and the team answered my question about filters the same afternoon.
The weighted blanket is excellent, I sleep so much better. Only thing to improve: your checkout added a 'handling fee' I didn't see until the last step. Feels sneaky.
Never arrived. Never got a reply from support either. Done with this shop.
My son's remote-control car stopped charging after two weeks. I emailed Toyvara and within a day they apologised and shipped a new one, no questions asked, no need to send the old one back.
The dress arrived in two days, folded in tissue paper inside a pretty box, felt like opening a present. Fabric is soft and it drapes beautifully.
Oh sure, 35 euros for a bag of dog treats the size of my fist. Very reasonable. Totally not a rip-off.

Packaging was excellent, every cable in its own bag, the console snug in foam. Shame the console itself overheats and shuts down after twenty minutes of play, and support's only advice was to 'keep it in a cooler room'.
I recommend Oakhill Tools to everyone renovating. Fair prices, and when I didn't know which drill bits to get, the guy on the phone spent ten minutes helping me pick.

Where do I start. The bed frame was supposed to arrive within 10 working days; it took five weeks, with the date pushed back three times by email, always the day before. When it finally came, the headboard panel was split along the grain because the box had nothing inside it except a couple of cardboard strips at the ends. I sent photos the same evening and was told damaged items must be reported within 24 hours, which I had done. After two more weeks of back-and-forth they offered a small voucher. I don't want a voucher, I want a bed that isn't broken.
The mirror arrived shattered because there was nothing but a thin cardboard sleeve around it. To their credit, customer service refunded me the same day after I sent one photo.

Bought a 1000-piece puzzle from Tessellate as a gift. Pieces fit snugly, the image is sharp, and there were no missing pieces. Great value at 14.99, and it came in a sturdy box without a single dent, which matters for a gift.
Returned a faulty blender on the 3rd of the month. Six weeks later, still no refund. Every email gets an automatic 'we're looking into it'.
Cheap and fast, but the charger stopped working in a week.
New climbing shoes from @Cragline 🧗 Fit like a glove straight out of the box and they grip like crazy. Plus 20% off with the spring code!
Three items, three separate deliveries, three huge boxes stuffed with plastic air pillows. Terrible for the environment, and I was stuck at home all week waiting for them.
The foundation shade was completely off from the website swatch, way too orange. The support chat was lovely about it though, and helped me find a better match for the exchange.
Arrived two days early and beautifully packed. Thank you so much!
My old Frostvale fridge lasted fifteen years. This new one from the same brand is already making a grinding noise after four months. They don't make them like they used to.
The seeds were cheap and germinated really well, almost every single one came up. However the 'express' shipping took eight days.
I am very satisfy with this order. The shoes are confortable and good material, and the price is very correct. Also the box is very nice, good for gift. Thank you.
Loved spending my Saturday morning on hold listening to the same twelve seconds of piano music. 10/10 customer experience, would wait an hour again.
The meal kits work out cheaper than my usual supermarket shop once you count the food I no longer throw away. Recipes are tasty and the ingredients are always fresh.

Delivery was fast and the driver was super friendly. The rug, however, is much thinner than it looks in the photos and already sheds everywhere. It came neatly rolled in a waterproof sleeve, so no complaints about the packing.

Switched my cat's food subscription to Mewbox because it's about a third cheaper than the vet clinic, and the boxes come in plain recyclable cardboard with no plastic. Their customer team even paused my orders while I was away, no fuss at all.

Had a question about the size of the ceiling lamp before ordering and got a detailed answer with measurements within an hour. The lamp came double-boxed with the glass shade wrapped separately. Zero issues.
Please use less packaging. One small moisturiser came in a box inside a box inside a padded envelope.

Mixed feelings about the Corvex tablet. The screen is bright and sharp, the speakers are surprisingly good, and it survived my kids dropping it on the kitchen tiles more than once. For the price I think it's one of the best deals out there. The problem was getting it: the order sat on 'preparing' for eight days and nobody could tell me why, and the chat agent I finally reached pasted the same FAQ link three times. If you're patient, the tablet itself is worth it.
Tracking was spot on, I got a text with a one-hour window and the courier arrived right in the middle of it. The trainers look even better in person, and they cost less than on the brand's own site.
Package arrive 2 weeks after the date, and tracking number not work never. I write three emails, nobody answer.
The armchair is gorgeous and surprisingly comfortable for the price. The delivery team, though, left it in the building lobby instead of bringing it up to the third floor as agreed.
Short version: great jeans, rubbish courier. Box was thrown over my fence into a puddle.
Eggs in a meal kit should not be loose at the bottom of the box under a bag of potatoes. Four of six broken, again.
Stunning coffee table, solid oak, no wobble at all, and the finish is flawless. The two delivery guys carried it in, placed it and even levelled it for me.
Fantastic, the vacuum works great... for the ten minutes the battery lasts.
Big 15 kg bag of cat litter delivered to my door in a day, no splits, wrapped in an extra plastic sleeve. Saves my back every month.
Paid a premium for 'gift packaging' and the watch came in a plain brown mailer with a sticker on it. Not worth the extra 8 dollars at all.
The tent is light, packs down small, and stayed bone dry through a night of heavy rain. Pricey for a two-person tent, and annoyingly the sale ended the day before I bought it.
Cheaper than the high street, and the lamp shade came nested in two boxes with foam corners. Not a mark on it.
Always on time, always well packed, and your staff actually know their products. That's why I keep coming back.
The organic veg box is lovely and fresh, but the plastic trays and film on every single item defeat the purpose of buying organic.
Day 12 of 'out for delivery'. Starting to think the courier and my new desk chair have eloped together. @SwiftRelay any news?
Got the Hearthline stand mixer during the anniversary sale for almost half off. Kneads bread dough without struggling, looks great on the counter, and came double-boxed without a dent.
I was charged a 15 euro 'restocking fee' for returning unopened shoes, which is not mentioned anywhere on the site. The agent on chat just said 'policy is policy' and closed the conversation.
Arrived super quick, but the mascara clumps terribly and flakes under my eyes by lunchtime.

The doll house came in perfect condition thanks to loads of cardboard inserts. My daughter hasn't stopped playing with it, and the little furniture pieces are really sturdy. The shop's chat even helped me find the matching figure set.
What made you choose us? The price, honestly. Lowest I found for a 65-inch TV by over a hundred euros, and that's why I'll be back.
Maybe text people when the driver is close? I missed my delivery twice because the time slot was so wide.
The solar lights are bright and switch on by themselves at dusk. They came loose in a single plastic bag, rattling around, and it's a miracle none of them broke.
The bike arrived a day early and 95% assembled. I couldn't get the brakes aligned myself, so I called and a technician walked me through it on video. Top service.
Honestly the worst online shopping experience of my life. Nobody at Crestway replies to emails, the phone line just rings out, and my order is still 'processing' after a month.
I wasn't expecting much for 12 euros, but these earbuds don't sound cheap at all. No complaints.

The book itself is a beautiful edition, cloth cover and ribbon marker. It came in a padded envelope with nothing else around it, so one corner was bent. Support offered a replacement straight away, though.
The oven was supposed to be delivered and installed on Tuesday. No one showed up, no one called. When I phoned, I was told the booking 'didn't exist'.
Obsessed with my new Lunebay pyjamas, softest cotton ever, and they came in a cute reusable pouch 💤

Great value, the 4-pack of towels costs what one towel costs elsewhere. They came rolled in a simple paper band with no plastic, which I appreciated. Sadly they lost their fluffiness after three washes.
The courier obviously dropped or threw the box: a big dent on one side, and the monitor inside has a cracked panel. The driver didn't even wait for me to check it.
Wanted to know if the stroller fits in a small car boot. The assistant on the chat measured one in the warehouse and sent me photos. Bought it straight away.
Overpriced junk, the handle broke on the very first use.
Next-day delivery as promised, can't fault that. But the same set of garden chairs is 40 pounds cheaper at other shops, which I only found out afterwards. Well packed, to be fair.
The kettlebell is solid cast iron with a smooth handle, no rough seams. Came in a reinforced box with plenty of protection, which for 16 kg is no small thing.
The exact same vitamins are 30% cheaper at Healvale. Not ordering here again.

What could we improve? A few things, honestly. The products themselves are great, I've bought three sets of bedding from you and they've all held up beautifully wash after wash. But the last two orders were a mess delivery-wise: one came four days after the promised date and the other was left with a neighbour I've never met, with no card or message. The tracking page said 'delivered to safe place', which was not true. Your prices are also creeping up; the same duvet cover is 12 pounds more than last spring. I'll probably stay, but I'm looking around.

I run a small dog-grooming business and order most of my supplies from Pawsmith. I've been meaning to write this for a while. Their shampoos and conditioners are gentle, smell lovely without being overpowering, and I've never had a dog react badly to them. Bulk pricing makes a real difference to my margins, easily 25% below the wholesaler I used before. Orders placed before noon arrive the next day, every time. And when I once had a question about a product for a dog with sensitive skin, their team put me in touch with the person who formulated it, who answered in detail. Can't recommend them enough.
This shampoo make my hair very dry and my scalp itchy. I use it one week only. Not recommend.
The kids love the science kit and we did every experiment twice. When I asked support which age each experiment suits, they sent back a detailed chart the same day.

It took ten days to arrive, and when it did the box was held together with tape and there was no protective wrap inside. The lamp base is scratched, and support offered me a 5% voucher, which is frankly an insult.
Best price on the market for this vacuum and it arrived the next day. Very happy.
Love the design and the colours are exactly like the pictures. But 90 dollars for a cotton t-shirt? Only bought it because it was a gift. The wrapping was gorgeous, at least.
Thank you so much for your wonderful customer service, said no one ever. Four emails, zero answers.
Can't say I've ever had a problem with delivery from this shop, and I've ordered at least twenty times. Never a broken item either, they know how to pack.

The coffee machine makes a great espresso with proper crema. Unfortunately the replacement filters cost a fortune, 20 euros for a pack of two. Their support did talk me through descaling on the phone, which was kind.

Needed a new dishwasher fast after mine flooded the kitchen. Ordered at lunchtime, installed the next morning, and the two engineers took the old one away and left the floor spotless. The phone team who booked it were patient with all my questions too.

Everything was perfect. I got help choosing the right mattress firmness over the phone, it arrived in three days vacuum-packed and spotless in a neat box, and it cost less than the showroom price for the same model. It's been two months and I'm sleeping like a baby, no sagging, no back pain.
The football is decent quality, holds air well, and the price was great. Delivery took forever though, almost three weeks, and the tracking link never worked.
Bought a cordless drill, battery died after one month. Support told me the battery isn't covered by the warranty. Great, thanks.
What did you like most? The packaging. Compostable, sturdy, and it kept the chocolates perfectly cool.
The automatic feeder works like a charm, portions are accurate and the app is simple. Getting help setting it up was another story: the hotline closes at 5pm and email took four days.
You raised the free-shipping minimum again and deliveries got slower at the same time. Not a great combination.
Huge thanks to the Fernbrook team! I had no idea how to transfer my data to the new laptop and they stayed on the phone with me for half an hour until it was all done.
Nice shoes, comfortable too, but awful packaging, the box was totally crushed.
Bought the Voltrix NB-200 here for 199 and a week later it was 139 on the same site. Asked for the difference back and they flatly refused.

The raised garden bed kit is thick galvanised steel and went together in under an hour. Delivery was quick and the driver even carried it round to the back garden. At 89 it was also the cheapest I could find.
Honestly the staff were lovely when I rang to ask about sizing, so I feel bad saying this, but the boots leak the moment you step into a puddle.
Tiny USB cable, giant box, mountain of plastic. Please do better.
